purpose: Teach: 不謹慎/憤慨/貫通/弱体/降下/命中/至難/浴びせ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さん前で不謹慎な雑談は医療チームで厳禁としております
lines.en: Ren — casual conversation in front of patients is strictly prohibited on the medical team.
lines.style: Even, measured rebuke. No edge — this is protocol, not personal. Steady eye contact. A pause before delivering the point so it lands cleanly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療事故への憤慨を医療チームで真摯に受け止めます
lines.en: Yes — the medical team takes any incident of negligence very seriously.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. Slightly formal register. A note of genuine concern beneath the protocol. Not defensive, but careful.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 血管を貫通する外傷ケアを、貴院、ご担当ですね、先生
lines.en: The trauma cases involving vessel puncture — your hospital handles those, correct?
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious. Soft delivery. Formality of 先生 carried with real deference, not ceremony. Seeking to understand, not test.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、免疫が弱体化した患者さんの対応を医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Yes — we're strengthening our protocols for immunocompromised patients across the team.
lines.style: Calm, procedural. A note of quiet commitment underneath. Not rushing through the answer. Measured pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急救命でヘリ降下を、貴院、毎月想定されてますね、先生
lines.en: So emergency helicopter responses are something your hospital drills for each month?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, warm tone. Not interrogating — asking to learn. A slight lean-in. The respect held steady but not stiff.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、治療部位に正確に命中する放射線治療を医療チームで導入します
lines.en: Yes — we've recently introduced precision radiotherapy targeting to improve treatment site accuracy.
lines.style: Direct, informative. Pride held lightly — this is the work, not a performance. Steady pace. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 至難の手術を、貴院、ご成功されたんですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital managed to pull off such a difficult surgery successfully, then.
lines.style: Warm appreciation, genuine. A note of almost bashful respect in the tone. Not gushing — sincere and simple. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療従事者へ罵声を浴びせる事案に医療チームで対策します
lines.en: Yes — we're implementing measures to address incidents of staff harassment and create a safer team environment.
lines.style: Measured, direct. A slight heaviness to this one — acknowledging something real happened. Not dwelling, but not glossing. Clear and steady.
